card.name: Words after motion or location verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, into, within, in, the) right after a verb of hauling, hearing or leaving, where a place noun would come next. The place is often a site, camp or region.

modes.label: Prepositions after movement
modes.description: A preposition follows a verb of moving things out of or into a place.
modes.example: The dump trucks haul the tar sands out<< of>> the mine to a separation unit where it

modes.label: Location or sound spread
modes.description: A word follows a verb of hearing or placement, before a location phrase.
modes.example: Firing was heard<< in>> the direction of New Madrid all day.

modes.label: Possessive before a site
modes.description: A possessive or modifier sits just before a facility or state name.

card.writes: It lowers building and room nouns such as house, room and building as the next word, so a place word of that kind is less likely.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words after verbs of moving or hearing, just before a place is named, and it steers away from saying building or room.
